milestone: MassBoot R2 / M2 FCC-guided unpowered board mapping
objective: Use the public FCC Ditoo Plus board geometry as the working map and a small set of exact-unit unpowered continuity/ohms checks to discriminate whether USB data, UART/reset/boot candidates, and SPI-NOR access justify a no-solder recovery route.

working_hypothesis.source: FCC A8I-DITOO-PLUS internal photos plus preserved AK1052D silicon/firmware evidence
working_hypothesis.rule: FCC geometry is a hypothesis source, not exact-unit proof; continuity may promote only physically measured connectivity.

preconditions.battery: disconnect through an ordinary accessible connector if straightforward before measurements; if not straightforward, stop and do not perform continuity/ohms measurements
preconditions.meter: known-good handheld multimeter in continuity or resistance mode only

allowed: passive visual comparison against FCC board photos
continuity/resistance measurements on exposed PCB pads, connector shells, connector solder pads, vias, test pads, and component terminals where probe placement is mechanically safe
identify GND by continuity to USB connector shell or other photographically obvious ground structure
map USB D+/D- from accessible USB connector solder-side features toward candidate passives/test pads without probing fine-pitch SoC pins
test continuity among candidate UART/reset/boot pads only when those pads are physically exposed and probe placement is stable
record open/no-continuity as a result rather than increasing probe force
forbidden: powering or booting the device while open
direct probing of fine-pitch AK1052D pins where a slip could bridge pins

measurement_order: confirm battery disconnected and USB absent
map accessible USB connector data-side continuity to nearby passives/test pads
map only clearly accessible candidate pad clusters suggested by FCC geometry
photograph and log every positive continuity pair
stop once evidence is sufficient to rank USB/UART/reset/boot/SPI next-step candidates

required_outputs: ranked UART0 TX/RX / GPIO6 boot-select / RESET candidate pads if measurable
SPI-NOR package/accessibility verdict from visual evidence
decision: no-solder SPI-read candidate vs reset-time MassBoot candidate vs insufficient access
analysis_contract.prohibition: Do not infer signal identity from proximity alone; exact signal promotion requires continuity or other later direct evidence.

risk.reason: Continuity/ohms mode is non-powered from the device perspective but a probe slip can still short adjacent nodes or damage connectors/components; battery disconnection and no fine-pitch SoC probing are required.

stop_if: probe access requires force or board flex
only fine-pitch SoC pins are available for a needed measurement
meter behavior is unstable or unexpected
stop_policy.after: No powered follow-up is implied. Any SPI clip, UART, GPIO strap, reset-time boot, USB enumeration, or MassBoot command requires a separate M3+ manifest and exact grant.

authority.grant_scope: ONE bounded exact-unit Ditoo Plus session of unpowered continuity/resistance mapping using exposed safe-access PCB points and FCC geometry as a hypothesis; battery disconnected, USB absent; no powered probing, voltage/current measurement, SoC fine-pitch probing, UART connection, GPIO/reset manipulation, SPI clip/programmer, MassBoot commands, firmware access, or soldering.
